markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (57%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged low-reliability simulated frozen section leaves InSitu (57%) and Invasive (35%) unseparated [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 57%, Invasive 35%, Benign 5%, Normal 2% | Leans InSitu; 35% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged); 100th OOD percentile (AUROC 0.70) [F6] | Suspect, out-of-distribution input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent backbones disagree |
| Similar cases | 20% InSitu (1/5) [F5]; nearest Invasive (74% similarity) | Weak reference neighborhood support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.18) pushes read away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 5) · context · Below-typical score (-0.22); descriptive context only [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.34) pushes read away from invasive [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.25 SD); unreliable concept (0/20 spot check) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI +0.002 to +0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen-section resampling degradation (severity 3) masks invasion; recut H&E and deeper levels are drafted.
- High-risk regions harbor invasion like nearest case BACH_0166 (Invasive, 74% similarity); defer surgical margin call [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 11, 10**: Inspect highest-risk heatmap regions (83%–97% risk) for stromal invasion versus resampling artifact.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 8**: Confirm atypical cells stay duct-confined, especially in higher-risk region 1 (72% risk).
3. **Regions 2, 5**: Check region 2 (81% risk, tubules) for invasion and region 5 for lymphocytic infiltrate.
